description: Send feedback about Close Knit to the team: a bug, missing or wrong data, an idea, or what worked. Call it only after the user agrees: show them the message first. Describe the product and what happened, never the person: no names, contact details, addresses, family, budget or other personal circumstances.

kind.description: bug = a tool failed or misbehaved; missing-data / wrong-data = an answer lacked or got a fact wrong; idea = something to add; praise = what worked well.

rating.description: How useful Close Knit was, 1-5, if the user said.
rating.title: Rating
